source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The quote-message patch removes a count==2 assertion and replaces it with a predicate that returns the number of matches. The earlier assertion already expects one match, so truthiness alone does not establish a second quote; the fixed test retains that expression. Its {children:true} options also need checking against the actual observer API. The separate inspected Gecko helper resolves immediately for a truthy check, but its pairing with this comm revision is unverified. Review acceptance and the stated intent to remove a delay are not proof of the expected result. No compose test ran.
title: Keep the expected quote count in a mutation-wait oracle
